_about: The route-feel gate's stated reasons (node tools/flow-audit.js gate; docs/ROUTE-FEEL.md). Each row accepts one check the candidate's flow audit fails against the shipped guides: `check` (score, backtracks_avoidable, passed_givers_near, passed_enders for a guide; back_and_forth, wasted_min, carried_far, carried_hours, never_handed, log_cap for a branch), the `guide` or `branch` it names ("*" for all), and the `mode` and `faction` it holds in (left out or "*": all; "run*": every mode with dungeons on Run). `reason` says why the route is better that way for players, on our own evidence: levels, time carried, a dangerous spot, a fixed report. Rows sorted by faction, guide or branch, check.

reasons.reason: Two walks back inside the Riverglades guide: Hurley offers Helping Hands only once Curly is found by the river (If a Tree Falls), and his escort walks back to her, about 500 yards; Sunnyglade's givers stand on the town's north side and its work starts at the ritual circles in the middle, about 360 yards back, a minute.

Each zone's own walks back: the Riverglades' two (Hurley's escort back to Curly; Sunnyglade's givers before its ritual circles) and Mount Hyjal's, which its own mode keeps as shipped; the gate compares this with the route that takes none of the three zones.
On the Mount Hyjal route the six quests of the last trip are now handed in after the zone instead of never; carrying them through Hyjal is the price.

Taking all three zones keeps the route's quests in the log longer, about 120 quest-hours more in all (flow model): the quests carried from the 50-60 guides ride through Mount Hyjal, and the 40-50 ones through the Riverglades and Shen'dralas. Each zone alone passes its own mode.

Maerion's Misery (97009): its Felhound Spikes drop from about one Defiling Hound in ten (one spike from eleven kills in the recording), so Mount Hyjal hands it in only as optional work; its Hyjal mode carries the same quest.

The Riverglades walk more than Desolace's south loop they replace: the ride in through Blackrock Pass, three hubs (Farholde Keep, Terral's Watch, Powderfuse Port) and the way out by Stormwind and Menethil Harbor; with 92 quests the route still reaches 60 about 4.5 hours sooner (flow model).
